## Main concepts

| Term                | Meaning                                                         |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Catalogue           | An inventory of reference tables and their versions.            |
| Reference table     | Rows of values used by consumers of a form.                      |
| Form model          | A definition selecting the tables and lookup columns it needs.  |
| Consumer            | An exporter, importer or validator using these references.       |

## Lookup configuration

| Term                | Meaning                                                         |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Lookup              | A table column and its matching settings.                       |
| Alias               | An alternate submitted value mapped to a canonical value.       |
| Matching policy     | Exact text or order-independent name matching and case handling.|

## Shared snapshots

| Term                | Meaning                                                         |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Reference snapshot  | Saved table data and lookup settings for reuse by consumers.     |
| Provenance          | Source path, checksum and availability recorded for a table.     |

Code lists and registries are ROS catalogues using the same generic retrieval and lookup mechanisms.
